subject: Life Skills
title: Notification Overload
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Notification Overload.

hook.text: The average smartphone user receives 80 notifications per day. Each one breaks concentration.

buildup.text: It takes about 23 minutes to fully refocus after an interruption, according to UC Irvine research.

discovery.text: Most notifications are not urgent. Apps send them to re-engage you, not to inform you.

twist.text: Turning off all notifications feels scary. But after a week, most people feel calmer and productive.

climax.text: Keep notifications only for calls, texts, and calendar. Silence everything else and check manually.

punchline.text: You check the app. Don't let it check on you.

quiz.question: How long does it take to refocus after a notification interruption?
